web_evidence.title: The Boleyn Inheritance — Excerpt
web_evidence.note: Copyright-attributed sustained excerpt presents Jane Boleyn narrating her own memories, circumstances, and hopes. Also locates q00401 within her opening narration. Establishes the opening only.

web_evidence.title: Philippa Gregory author interview
web_evidence.note: Asked specifically about this novel's multiple voices, Gregory explains her choice of first-person narration through Anne of Cleves, Katherine Howard, and Jane Boleyn.

web_evidence.title: The Boleyn Inheritance — Historical Novel Society
web_evidence.note: Ilysa Magnus explicitly identifies alternating narratives by the three women, all telling their stories in first person; independently corroborates the author's structural account.

search_log: Searched: "The Boleyn Inheritance" Philippa Gregory excerpt.
Opened and read the BookBrowse excerpt, Gregory's BookBrowse interview, and the Historical Novel Society review; these establish opening narration and whole-book structure.
person_note: The novel rotates among three participating first-person narrators: Anne of Cleves, Katherine Howard, and Jane Boleyn. Multiple first-person voices remain FIRST. Diagnostic Goodreads narration agrees with the authorized opening and two explicit whole-book descriptions. Speech and maxims do not contribute person evidence; descriptions of other characters do not establish third-person narration. Remaining uncertainty concerns isolated clipped quotations, especially q00402, rather than the book's narrative structure.
